name: Rac family small GTPase 2

function.text: RAC2 encodes ras-related C3 botulinum toxin substrate 2. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activity and G protein activity. It participates in signal transduction and chemotaxis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to immunodeficiency 73b with defective neutrophil chemotaxis and lymphopenia (autosomal dominant); immunodeficiency 73c with defective neutrophil chemotaxis and hypogammaglobulinemia (autosomal recessive). Additional curated associations are listed below.
